package.name: parkerstage
package.description:
Parker 401200XR/401XR150 compound XYZ linear stage (2x 200 mm stroke stacked in XY, plus a 150 mm vertical Z stage on the X carriage).
Contains the URDF (three prismatic slide joints centered on the physical mid-stroke, box collision geometry for Gazebo/MuJoCo, and mesh-derived aluminum inertials), the STL meshes, and a launch file that brings up robot_state_publisher, joint_state_publisher_gui and rviz.
The URDF references meshes via package://parkerstage/meshes/...
